findings.detail: B01 counted 82 investment leaves without fair_value even though the 2025 SOI pages carry a Fair Value column and investment rows, including dash-valued zero positions, have source fair value cells.

rationale: B01 is an aggregate coverage flag: 205 of 287 leaves have fair_value, below the 0.95 threshold. The raw 2025 SOI is organized with a Fair Value column across the investment schedule, and source rows include explicit fair value cells, including dash-valued zero fair values. The low coverage therefore reflects an extraction/normalization gap for source fair value cells rather than a source absence.
